entries.title: Duplicate warp threads are removed
entries.root_cause: The warp expansion function converts thread identifiers to a set, dropping repetitions that must be preserved. Retain the input sequence when expanding the warp.

entries.title: Empty palette cannot be decoded
entries.root_cause: The palette decoder calls parse-long on an empty field and uses the resulting nil as a number. Handle the empty palette representation in the decoder.

entries.title: Repeated warp threads are still dropped
entries.root_cause: The warp expansion function converts thread identifiers to a set, dropping repetitions that must be preserved. Retain the input sequence when expanding the warp.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later run uses a different runner and expanded fixture; the same duplicate removal fails a second warp assertion.

entries.title: Weft threads are returned in reverse order
entries.root_cause: The weft expansion function prepends each thread while reducing, reversing the expected order. Append threads or reverse the result in the weft expansion function.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Like the warp failure, an expansion test compares thread vectors, but the weft output contains all threads in reverse order and requires a separate implementation fix.
